title: Time Confirm
summary: Asks AM or PM when a typed time is ambiguous and catches times a clock change skips or repeats, so meetings aren't 12 hours off.
description: Time input that asks AM or PM when a time is ambiguous, spells out noon and midnight, catches times a DST change skips (one-tap move to the real time) or repeats (pick which), and shows the moment in other zones with day-shift flags.
catches: Times skipped by a DST change, with a move to the first real time
Times repeated by a DST change, with a choice of which
Other zones' times, flagged when they fall on another day
limits: Needs a date and IANA time zone for DST checks
Parses common English time formats only
assume24h changes how bare hours are read
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and hint via aria-describedby
AM/PM choice is a roving-tabindex radiogroup with arrow keys
Hint in a polite live region
